description: Kentucky weatherization helps eligible households improve home energy efficiency without paying for approved work. Applications go to the local weatherization provider.
introduction: Kentucky weatherization helps eligible households improve home energy efficiency without paying for approved work. Applications go to the local weatherization provider.

who: KHC lists household income at or below 200 percent of the poverty level and a rolling 15-year prior-weatherization rule. The provider evaluates the dwelling and application.
Homeowners and renters can apply. A rental property requires written landlord permission.
sections.get: An energy assessment determines appropriate improvements, such as insulation, air sealing, duct work or heating-system work. The program does not promise every listed improvement to every home.
sections.docs: KHC asks for occupants’ Social Security numbers and monthly income verification, utility bills or account records, and ownership proof or a landlord agreement. Ask the provider how to submit sensitive records securely.
sections.apply:
1. Open KHC’s weatherization page and follow Find Your Local Weatherization Provider.
  2. Contact that provider for intake and submit the requested records.
  3. If renting, obtain the landlord agreement. Arrange access for assessment when the provider schedules it.
sections.after: Ask about the waiting list, planned work and any condition preventing safe installation. Do not hire a contractor expecting reimbursement unless the provider has explicitly authorized it. Retain the work and inspection paperwork and ask how to operate any new equipment.
sections.sources:
• KHC weatherization for households
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Yes. Kentucky requires written permission from the landlord for rental weatherization.
Is this a payment for my overdue bill?
No. It funds approved energy-efficiency work. Ask the local community action agency separately about LIHEAP bill assistance.
Can I choose a replacement furnace?
The assessment determines approved measures. A replacement is not automatic just because heating equipment is old.
Where should I send the application?
Use the local provider linked from KHC’s consumer weatherization page, rather than the partner grant-application pages.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
